steps.name: Show pizza dough
positives: A plain and empty pizza base or dough is clearly visible. Only answer with [yes] or [no]

steps.name: Add lettuce
positives: Green Lettuce leaves are visible on top of the pizza base. Only answer with [yes] or [no]

steps.name: Add ham
positives: Do you clearly see slices of ham or bacon, visible on top of green Lettuce. Only answer with [yes] or [no]

steps.name: Add black olives
positives: At least multiple black olives are visible on top of green Lettuce. Only answer with [yes] or [no]

steps.name: Add chilli red peppers
positives: Are there red peppers are visible in the frame? Only answer with [yes] or [no]

steps.name: Add some Jalapeno peppers
positives: Are At least multiple green jalapeno pepper slices visible on top of an unprepared pizza? Only answer with [yes] or [no]

steps.name: Thumbs up
positives: Do you see a hand very clearly doing a thumbs-up or thumbsup gesture?, Only answer with [yes] or [no]
